name: plugins
description: Handoff Academy plugins for practical workflows across Claude and compatible agent platforms.

plugins.name: ai-strategist
plugins.description: Interviews you about your business and your life, then designs the AI hub that runs them: which Claude Projects to create, what each one reads, and what runs on a schedule. Runs as a Quick Plan or as the full interview, and labels every capability line it could not check.

plugins.name: handoff-team
plugins.description: Your AI team's office: a Chief of Staff and helpers that work from your second brain of plain notes, shown in a friendly Team View. Starts from an empty folder, backs up to a private GitHub copy, runs a morning shift in the cloud, and only ever writes drafts.

plugins.name: video-editor
plugins.description: Turns a raw talking-head video into a finished vertical short: cuts the stumbles and long pauses, opens on a hook, adds word-by-word captions, zooms and sound, and checks the finished file before you post. Runs in Claude Cowork with nothing to install on your computer.
